features.title: Family Hub
features.description: Sets up the Theme Builder sidebar panel and the Family Week Calendar card - nothing on the next few screens is required, and everything here can also be changed later via Configure. Which of these would you like to set up now? Anything left unchecked is skipped below (and can still be turned on any time later, from the card's own Settings or Configure).

users.title: Add users
users.description: Who's in the household? Pick the Home Assistant logins that should be Family Hub members - this is what makes someone show up on the Users/Permissions tabs, the Chores board, and every chore/reward/routine assignment picker. Leave this empty if you'd rather add people later from the card's own Settings > Users tab.

member_profile.title: Set up {member_name}
member_profile.description: A board color for {member_name} (shown on the Chores/Rewards board and calendar), and whether they're included in Chores & Rewards at all - on by default; turn it off for a member who shouldn't get a Chores column or a stars balance (e.g. an adult who just wants the calendar). Optionally pick their own calendar too - it becomes their column on the family calendar, in their color. Everything here is editable any time from the calendar card's Settings.

data.member_calendar: Their own calendar (optional - becomes their column on the family calendar)

chores_features.title: Chores, Rewards & Routines
chores_features.description: A few more optional switches for the Chores board - all off by default, and all reachable later too from the card's own Settings > General > "Chores, Rewards & Routines".

data.goals_in_chores: Show Goals on the Chores board
data.goals_in_rewards: Show Goals on the Rewards page

calendars.title: Family calendar
calendars.description: Which calendars should appear on the family calendar? Pick shared ones here - a Family calendar, a school calendar, a child without their own login. (Each member's own calendar was already picked on their own screen.) Every calendar here and every member's own calendar is also watched for event reminders. You can add, rename or link calendars to people any time in the calendar card's Settings > General > Calendars.

grocy.title: Grocy (optional)
grocy.description: Connect a self-hosted Grocy instance to add Grocy recipes to your meals, the recipe viewer and importer, a grocery list from the week's meals, your Grocy shopping list, stock on the My Pantry card, and Expiring Soon and Low Stock lists. Leave both fields blank if you don't use Grocy; this can be added later from Configure.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Pick a default target for calendar event reminders (used whenever a calendar doesn't have its own override). Can be left blank and set later from the card's own Settings or Configure > Calendar reminders.

data.default_notify_target: Default target for calendar reminders (e.g. notify.mobile_app_pixel_6a)

digest.title: Daily Digest (optional)
digest.description: Turn on a once-a-day notification summarizing today's events, due reminders, and planned meals - sent whether or not anyone has the dashboard open. Off by default; pick a time and who should receive it if you'd like it on now, or leave it off and turn it on later from the card's Settings or Configure.

finish.title: All set
finish.description:
⚙️ **Settings live on the Family Week Calendar card.** Add that card to a dashboard first: its ⚙️ button is the only place to change Family Hub's settings (people, permissions, calendars, themes and more), for every card.

Family Hub is ready. Here's a quick tour of the cards - add any of them to a dashboard (Edit dashboard > Add card, then search "Family"):

- 📅 **Family Week Calendar** - everyone's calendars, reminders and the meal plan in week, month, day or planner view, plus Settings for all of Family Hub.
- ☀️ **Family Today** - today at a glance: events, meals and reminders that are due.
- 🕒 **Family Right Now** - what each person is doing now and what's next, with Home/Away.
- ✅ **Family Hub Chores** - a column per person plus the Chore Bin; finish chores to earn stars, with daily routines.
- ⭐ **Family Hub Rewards** - everyone's star balance and the rewards to spend stars on.
- 🎯 **Family Hub My Goals** - bigger goals with a reward at the end, like "practice piano 5 times".
- 📝 **Family Hub To-Do Lists** - your Home Assistant to-do lists side by side, including wish lists.
- 📖 **Family Hub Recipe Box** - your family's favorite dishes - search them and add them to the meal plan.
- 🥫 **Family Hub My Pantry** - what's in stock, from Grocy (if you use it).
- ⏲️ **Family Hub Active Timers** - every timer running in the house, and quick timers to start.
- 🖼️ **Family Hub Screen Saver** - photos or a clock when the screen's idle.
- 🎨 **Theme Builder: Theme Selector** - lets each screen pick its own theme.

Reminders go to: {default_notify}
Daily Digest: {daily_digest}

You can change these any time with Configure, or in the calendar card's Settings.

abort.already_configured: Family Hub is already configured. Use Configure to change reminder settings, test a notification, or install an update.

settings.title: Family Hub Settings
settings.description: Most Family Hub settings - theme, per-person notifications, Chores & Rewards options, the screensaver, and more - live inside the Family Hub calendar card itself, not here. Open the dashboard where the card is added, and tap the ⚙️ Settings button in the card's top-right corner. (Calendar reminders, Grocy, and updates are configured from this Configure menu instead - see the other options here.)

grocy.title: Grocy
grocy.description: Optional: connect a self-hosted Grocy instance to add Grocy recipes to your meals, the recipe viewer and importer, a grocery list from the week's meals, your Grocy shopping list, stock on the My Pantry card, and Expiring Soon and Low Stock lists. Leave both fields blank if you don't use Grocy. The API key is stored here, in Family Hub's own integration settings - not in the card's Settings panel.

reminders.title: Calendar reminders
reminders.description: Pick calendars to monitor - Family Hub polls these for events with a reminder set (via the calendar card's 'Remind me' field). Leave calendars empty to turn reminders off. WHO gets notified is now managed per-person from the calendar card's own Settings > Users tab, where each Home Assistant login subscribes to the calendars/reminders/digest they want - the default target and per-calendar overrides below are the OLD household-wide settings, kept only as a record of what this install used to have (they were converted into starting per-user profiles the first time this version ran, and are no longer read by anything).

test_notify.title: Test a notification
test_notify.description: Pick any registered notify target and Family Hub will send it a test message right now - independent of calendars or reminders. Use this to confirm a device is reachable before wiring it into a calendar, or to rule notify delivery in or out if reminders aren't arriving.

restore_backup.title: Backups
restore_backup.description: Restore a saved snapshot, export one to a file, or import a snapshot from a file.

menu_options.export_backup: Export a snapshot to a file
menu_options.import_backup: Import a snapshot from a file

restore_backup_confirm.title: Restore a backup
restore_backup_confirm.description:
Restoring the snapshot from {when}. This will replace your current Users, Permissions, calendars, and other household Settings. A safety snapshot of what you have right now will be taken automatically first.

Would you also like to restore and push out each device's own saved settings (view/layout, screen saver, etc.)? This is off by default - most of the time you only want the household Settings restored, not every tablet's individual display settings rolled back too.

data.push_device_settings: Also restore and push per-device settings

update.title: Update Family Hub
update.description: Install a new family_hub_vN.zip without touching the file system. The current install is backed up automatically before anything is overwritten. Home Assistant needs a restart afterward (Settings > System > Restart) to load the new code - your themes, calendars, and reminders are untouched either way.

restore_backup_pick.title: Restore a backup
restore_backup_pick.description: Family Hub automatically saves a snapshot of your Settings, Permissions, and Device Settings every 12 hours (at midnight and noon) and keeps the last 8. Pick one below to restore - a safety snapshot of the current state is always taken first, so this is never a one-way door.

export_backup.title: Export a backup
export_backup.description: Pick a snapshot to save as a file. The next screen has a link that downloads it to this device, and a copy is also saved in Home Assistant's config folder (family_hub_backups/exports). Keep it somewhere safe, or import it into another installation.

import_backup.title: Import a backup
import_backup.description: Upload a backup file previously created with Export a backup (from this install or another one). It's added as a new snapshot you can restore - nothing changes until you pick it from Restore a snapshot afterward.

abort.update_installed: Installed version {version}. Restart Home Assistant (Settings > System > Restart) to finish loading the update.
abort.test_sent: Test notification sent to {target}. If it didn't arrive, check that device/service directly in Developer Tools > Actions, or check its own connectivity/registration (e.g. the Home Assistant Companion app on the phone) - Family Hub only hands off to the service, it doesn't control delivery from there.
abort.no_backups: No Settings-history snapshots exist yet - Family Hub takes the first one automatically at the next midnight or noon, or right away with Back up now in the calendar card's Settings > Developer tools. If you need to recover sooner, use a full Home Assistant backup instead (Settings > System > Backups).
abort.restore_done: Restored the snapshot from {when}. Per-device settings pushed live: {devices}. A safety snapshot of what you had right before this restore was saved automatically.
abort.export_done: Exported the snapshot from {when}. {download_link} (the link expires in 5 minutes), or copy the file from {path} via Samba/SSH/a Terminal add-on.
abort.import_done: Imported the snapshot from {when}. It's now available to restore from Restore a snapshot - importing it here didn't change anything yet.

error.invalid_target: "{target}" isn't a valid notify target - it should look like notify.mobile_app_something.
error.invalid_backup_file: That file doesn't look like a Family Hub backup export: {error}. Make sure you're uploading a .json file created by Family Hub's own Export a backup step.

nav.shopping_list_title: View and add to your Grocy shopping list
nav.expiring_soon_title: Items in Grocy stock expiring within 30 days
nav.low_stock_title: Items in Grocy stock below their minimum amount
nav.daily_digest_title: Your own Daily Digest, any time
nav.privacy_mode_title: Hide reminders and calendar events until someone with the privacy mode privilege unlocks it

add_event.remind_hint: Needs the Family Hub integration installed to actually notify.
add_event.rollover_label: Roll over to next day if not completed
add_event.rolldays_hint: Applies only on these days (leave every day selected to roll over daily, same as before)
add_event.reminder_hint: Saved as a to-do in Home Assistant, not an event on your calendar - fires once at this exact time, and you can mark it done, edit it, or reschedule it anytime from the event-info popup or Home Assistant's own To-do UI. Who gets notified is set per person under Settings > Users.
add_event.no_writable_calendars: None of these calendars accept new events from here - add a calendar that does under Settings > Calendars.
add_event.checklist_hint: A "just for this" list is deleted automatically once this happens (plus a grace window, so it doesn't vanish mid-use) - an existing list you attach is only ever unlinked, never touched or deleted itself.
add_event.checklist_no_items: No items yet - add whatever needs to be remembered below.
add_event.category_setup_hint: No categories yet. Add them under Settings → General → Calendars.

event_info.duplicate_hint: Change anything you like - the copy is added to the same calendar and this event stays as it is.
event_info.duplicate_need: Give it a title and a date.
event_info.duplicate_need_time: Pick a start and end time.
event_info.duplicate_failed: Couldn't add the copy - try again
event_info.replace_meal_confirm: %block% already has "%existing%" planned. Replace it with "%new%"?
event_info.delete_unsupported_title: This calendar integration doesn't support deleting events from here.
event_info.delete_unsupported_alert: Delete is not supported with your current calendar integration. Please use %integration% to delete this event.
event_info.read_only_note: Events on %calendar% can't be changed from here - edit them in %integration%.
event_info.delete_confirm: Delete "%summary%"? This can't be undone here - it removes the event from %person%'s calendar.
event_info.checklist_load_failed: Couldn't load this list right now.
event_info.also_for_needs_users: Add people under Settings > Users and pick each one's own calendar to tag them here.
event_info.chore_bin_hint: This chore is in the Chore Bin. Grab it on the Chores card.
event_info.chore_done_failed: Couldn't mark it done. Only the person it's for, or someone allowed to complete anyone's chores, can.

more_menu.locked_no_pin: This is locked, and nobody who can open it has a PIN yet. An admin can set one under Settings > Users.

settings.calendar_color_none: This calendar has no color of its own in Home Assistant.
settings.alarm_device_legacy: Not linked yet - it only rings for "Them + kiosks" or "Everyone" alarms until you pick who it's for.
settings.alarm_device_test_ok: Sent - you should hear it now.
settings.alarm_device_test_no_tts: Pick a text-to-speech voice below first - speakers need one.
settings.alarm_device_test_failed: That didn't work - check the device in Home Assistant.
settings.alarm_devices_hint: Speakers (Google Home, Nest, Sonos...) and Assist satellites that announce timer alarms, repeating until someone taps Stop. Tick who each one rings for: a person's timers, chores and rewards ring on their speakers, and House timers (nobody assigned, like the oven) ring on the house ones. "Them + kiosks" alarms also ring the house speakers, and "Everyone" rings them all.
settings.more_menu_locked_load_error: Couldn't load this locked pop-up - try again.
settings.more_menu_lock: Lock it - only the people below can open it
settings.more_menu_lock_hint: On their own phone or login it opens straight away. On a shared or kiosk screen it asks for their PIN (set under Settings > Users). Good for addresses, emergency contacts or anything private.
settings.more_menu_lock_pick: Pick at least one person who can open it.
settings.more_menu_lock_save_failed: Saved, but a locked pop-up's content didn't save - only an admin can change it. Try again.
settings.more_menu_icon_hint: An emoji, or a Home Assistant icon like mdi:camera. Left empty, it's 📌.
settings.more_menu_qr_link_hint: For example the shared photo album your screen saver shows, so guests can add pictures.
settings.more_menu_qrf_show: Also show the network name and password in the pop-up
settings.more_menu_qr_wifi_hint: Guests point their phone camera at the code and tap to join - no typing.
settings.more_menu_qr_contact_hint: Scanning offers to save this contact - handy for a babysitter or a neighbor.
settings.more_menu_qr_phone_hint: Scanning offers to call this number.
settings.more_menu_qr_sms_hint: Scanning opens a text message, already written, ready to send.
settings.more_menu_qr_email_hint: Scanning opens an email, already addressed.
settings.more_menu_qr_incomplete: Fill in the QR code details (or choose No QR code).
settings.more_menu_hint: Choose which buttons the ⋮ More menu shows and in what order, and add your own buttons. Each one opens a pop-up with a heading, text, up to 2 photos, a QR code and a link - for example a QR code family can scan to add photos to the screen saver album. Applies to every device.
settings.more_menu_qr_hint: Paste a link (or any text, like Wi-Fi details) and it's shown as a QR code people can scan with their phone camera - for example a shared photo album for the screen saver.
settings.more_menu_link_invalid: The link needs to start with http:// or https://
settings.more_menu_qr_too_long: That's too long for a QR code.
settings.heading: Settings
settings.calendars_hint: Tap ⏳ on a calendar to include its events in the countdown banner. Use ➕ Add badge to show a small bubble (like "N", in that calendar's color) on days with events matching a keyword, and optionally hide events matching another keyword. Who gets notified about a calendar's events/reminders is set per-person under the Users tab, not here.
settings.calendars_hint_v2: Each calendar here shows on the calendar. Choose who it belongs to in its person menu ("Not linked" means shared): someone's first calendar becomes their column, and any more of theirs are shown inside it. ⏳ adds its events to the countdown banner; ➕ Add badge shows a small bubble on days with matching events. Who gets reminders is set per person under the Users tab.
settings.manage_calendars_hint: Which calendars belong to someone is set in one place: Settings > General > Calendars. Choose their name in a calendar's person menu there - their first calendar becomes their column, and any more are shown inside it.
settings.get_reminders_from_hint: Tap a calendar to get its event reminders and Daily Digest entries (✓ = on). Calendars that belong to someone are grouped under their name - tap the name to pick all of theirs at once, or the arrow to pick individually.
settings.no_calendar_column: No calendar of their own yet.
settings.member_color_hint: Their color on the calendar (their own calendar column follows it) and on the Chores board and Rewards balances. Leave unset to use the automatically assigned color. The bar on the right always shows their actual current color - tap it to open the picker.
settings.calendar_linked_user_title: Link this calendar to a household member
settings.calendar_secondary_tag_title: Also added as an extra calendar under this household member’s profile (Users tab)
settings.extra_calendars_hint: Read-only overlay calendars - their events show up in this person's own column alongside their own calendar above, but can't be edited or deleted from the dashboard. To get notified/reminded about one of these too, subscribe to it under Calendars above.
settings.layout_presets_label: Layout ideas — this device only (tap one to fill in the fields below, then Save)
settings.layout_preset_week_desc: One row, all 7 days at a glance — the classic view
settings.layout_preset_portrait_desc: Same 7 days split into 2 rows — bigger text for a tall or portrait-mounted screen
settings.layout_preset_agenda_desc: A scrolling list instead of a grid — best for small screens or a quick glance
settings.layout_preset_two_week_desc: 14 days across 2 rows — plan meals and activities further out
settings.week_button_shows_label: Week button shows — this device only
settings.days_shown_label: Days shown in Week view — this device only (smaller displays: fewer columns)
settings.month_button_shows_label: Month button shows — this device only
settings.show_hours_label: Show hours of the day (timeline) — this device only
settings.grey_out_label: Dim events/reminders that have already passed
settings.grey_out_hint: Today's events dim one by one as they end; any earlier day is dimmed entirely, since the whole day is already over.
settings.fab_position_hint: "Dashboard corner" pins the + button to the bottom-right of the whole screen (today's behavior). "This card's corner" anchors it to the bottom-right of THIS card instead - useful when this card shares a dashboard row/column with other cards, so the button doesn't float off in a corner unrelated to it.
settings.top_bar_style_label: Calendar top bar style — this device only
settings.top_bar_style_hint: Minimal hides the top bar (Settings/Week/Month/Edit Meals/Suggestions/Recipe Box/More) to save space on a small device - Settings moves into the + button's menu instead, right alongside Calendar Entry/Reminder/Meal Suggestion/Recipe. Saved to THIS device/browser only, like the Days shown/Month button settings above - choosing Minimal here won't affect any other Family Hub tablet or screen in the household.
settings.bottom_padding_hint: px - reserves extra space at the bottom of the card (e.g. for a dock, taskbar, or on-screen keyboard)
settings.meal_plan_list_hint: The to-do list the weekly menu is stored on. Leave blank and tap "+ Add list" to create one automatically.
settings.weather_entity_hint: The weather entity each day-column's forecast is pulled from. Leave blank to use the dashboard's own config (or Home Assistant's weather.forecast_home default).
settings.show_meal_plan_month_label: Show meal plan in month view
settings.routines_label: Routines (per-person daily checklists on the Chores board)
settings.routines_hint: One household-wide switch - once on, everyone gets Morning/Afternoon/Night checklist accordions on their own column of the Chores board.
settings.goals_show_on_hint: Chores page adds each person's goals to their own column of the Chores board, with Log Progress/Approve/Send Back actions right there. Rewards page adds a Goals section to the Rewards page alongside the star catalog.
settings.confetti_label: Confetti when a chore is completed
settings.confetti_hint: Pops a quick confetti animation across the screen whenever someone marks a chore done on the Chores board.
settings.danger_zone_hint: Permanently deletes every chore (or goal) regardless of status - open, awaiting approval, or already done. There's no undo. Only visible to real Home Assistant admin accounts.
settings.cycle_countdown_label: Cycle through all upcoming countdown items
settings.cycle_countdown_hint: Add more than one item above (or mark events/reminders "Use as countdown") to see this in action — with only one item there's nothing to cycle through.
settings.digest_hint: Sends one notification each morning summarizing today's events, meals, and due reminders — independent of anyone having the dashboard open. Who gets a digest, and what's in theirs, is set per-person under the Users tab; this just turns the feature on and picks the household's send time.
settings.grocy_hint: Connect Grocy itself under Settings → Devices & Services → Family Hub → Configure → Grocy - the toggles below only control which optional Grocy-powered features show up on the card once it's connected. Everything here is off by default.
settings.track_expiring_hint: Adds an "Expiring Soon" list under the More menu. Whether it's also offered in anyone's Daily Digest is set under the Users tab once this is on.
settings.track_low_stock_hint: Adds a "Low Stock" list under the More menu (products below their own minimum stock amount, with a one-tap button to add them all to the shopping list). Whether it's also offered in anyone's Daily Digest is set under the Users tab once this is on.
settings.screensaver_hint: Shows a full-screen video or live camera feed after the dashboard sits idle for a while - built for a wall-mounted display. The source and idle time below are shared by the whole household; which logins actually see it is controlled per Home Assistant user further down, so a tablet's own login can have it on while a phone's stays off.
settings.video_url_hint: A direct link to a video file, or a path under Home Assistant's own /local/ media folder. Loops muted and silently while showing.
settings.idle_hint: Any tap on the screen dismisses it and starts the countdown over.
settings.disable_recipe_open_label: Disable while a recipe is open
settings.disable_recipe_open_hint: Pauses the idle countdown while a single recipe's detail view is open (Recipe Box or the Grocy recipe viewer) - browsing the recipe list itself still counts as idle.
settings.return_dashboard_label: Return to this dashboard on wake
settings.return_dashboard_hint: Optional. If the screensaver falls asleep here and gets tapped awake, it jumps to this dashboard/view instead of staying on this one - handy if the wall tablet gets left on some other view during the day. Leave blank to just stay put.
settings.device_theme_hint: Overrides the shared theme above for just this device/tablet - every other Family Hub card here (Chores, Rewards, Goals, My Pantry, My Chores) picks it up too, but no other device is affected. Takes effect immediately, with no Save needed.
settings.notify_click_path_hint: Optional. When set, tapping a reminder, event, or Daily Digest push notification opens this Home Assistant dashboard/view instead of just launching the app - use a relative path like /lovelace-family/0 (dashboard + view) or /lovelace/calendar (a view's own path). Applies to every notification this backend sends. Needs the Home Assistant Companion app.
settings.add_member_hint: Add a Home Assistant login to make them part of Family Hub - only people added here show up on this list, on the Permissions tab, and on the Chores board.
settings.profiles_hint: Each Home Assistant login has its own profile here - which calendars they get reminders from, whether they want standalone Reminders, and whether/what they want in the Daily Digest. Tap a person below to set theirs up, or Remove to take them out of Family Hub - nothing about them is deleted, and re-adding them brings everything right back.
settings.no_members_yet: Nobody's been added to Family Hub yet. Use "Add a person" above to get started.
settings.chores_rewards_color_hint: Their color on the Chores board columns and Rewards balances. Leave unset to use the automatically assigned color. The bar on the right always shows their actual current color - tap it to open the picker.
settings.include_chores_rewards_hint: Turn this off to keep them a full Family Hub member (still shown here, on the Permissions tab, and in Routines) without a Chores board column or Rewards balance, and without offering them as a new chore assignee. Handy for a shared login - a wall-mounted tablet, say - that needs Permissions granted but isn't an actual person. Existing chores/rewards history is never affected.
settings.child_account_hint: When they log into Home Assistant and open this card's own Settings, they'll see even less than an ordinary non-admin does - everything a non-admin already can't see, PLUS the whole Users tab (including this very profile). Admin-only, same as Kiosk PIN login and Permissions below - a child can never turn this off for themselves.
settings.account_type_hint: Chores: on by default - tap to turn off and keep them a full Family Hub member (still shown here, on the Permissions tab, and in Routines) without a Chores board column or Rewards balance, and without offering them as a new chore assignee; tap again to turn back on. Handy for a shared login - a wall-mounted tablet, say - that needs Permissions granted but isn't an actual person. Existing chores/rewards history is never affected. Child/Kiosk (admin-only): you can only be one or the other - picking one turns the other off, and tapping the one that's already on turns it off (neither selected = an ordinary account). Child: when they log into Home Assistant and open this card's own Settings, they'll see even less than an ordinary non-admin does - everything a non-admin already can't see, PLUS the whole Users tab (including this very profile) - a child can never turn this off for themselves. Kiosk: for a shared wall-mounted tablet login, not a real person - restricts Settings the same way, and turning it on also turns on Always-on alarm kiosk and this person's own Kiosk PIN login below as a starting point (you can still flip either back off afterward); new devices reporting in while logged in as a Kiosk account default to participating in Privacy Mode.
settings.presence_hint: Pick a person or device_tracker entity to show a Home/Away pill for them on the standalone "Right Now" card. Leave blank to show no presence pill for this person.
settings.extra_sensors_label: Other sensors & switches to show (battery, etc.)
settings.extra_sensors_hint: Any entity at all - a phone’s battery level, a door left open, a switch or light to flip on and off. Shown as a small pill next to this person’s presence pill on the standalone "Right Now" card. Tapping a pill toggles it (switches, lights, and similar) or opens its more-info dialog (everything else, including presence/battery/other sensors). Battery sensors get their own low-battery color automatically.
settings.no_calendars_added: No calendars added yet - add one under the General tab's Calendars section first.
settings.calendars_tap_hint: Tap a card to subscribe them to reminders from that calendar. Tap the star to make it their primary calendar - that calendar's events follow their own color above instead of its own configured color, everywhere it's shown on the dashboard. Calendars already claimed by a household member are grouped under their name - tap the name to subscribe to all of theirs at once, or tap the arrow to pick individually.
settings.own_calendar_hint: Set this directly here if their calendar isn't already added under the General tab's Calendars section - it'll show up as its own column on the calendar, labeled with their name and their color above, without needing to also add it under Calendars. If it's ALSO added there, this profile's own color/badges win for it.
settings.their_reminders_list_hint: Their own individual Reminders list, separate from the shared family Reminders list. Leave blank and tap "+ Add list" to create one automatically.
settings.their_wishlist_hint: A to-do list just for their own wish list - saving automatically flags it, same as the To-Do Lists card's own Wish List toggle. Leave blank and tap "+ Add list" to create one automatically.
settings.no_other_reminder_lists: Nobody else has their own individual Reminders list set up yet - add one to a person under the General tab's Calendars section first.
settings.other_reminder_lists_hint: Everyone always sees their own list. For anyone else's: "None" keeps it fully out of sight, "Add to calendar" shows it on this person's own calendar (colored with its owner's color) with no push, and "...+ alert" also sends a notification the moment one of its reminders comes due. Anyone subscribed at either level can add new reminders to that list too.
settings.instant_reward_claimed: A reward is claimed (anyone in the household)
settings.instant_chore_approved: One of my chores is approved
settings.instant_chore_rejected: One of my chores is sent back (not approved)
settings.instant_chore_due: One of my chores is due soon (uses that chore's own "remind me" times)
settings.instant_timer_alarm: One of my timers goes off (alarm-style: bypasses silent mode/DND on your phone)
settings.instant_hint: Sent right away, separate from the Daily Digest below - not folded into tomorrow morning's summary.
settings.send_test_digest_hint: Sends what's currently checked above (even if not Saved yet) to this person's notify targets, right now - handy for checking a device actually gets it and previewing today's content.
settings.kiosk_enable_login: Enable logging in as this person on a shared kiosk display
settings.kiosk_login_hint: Once enabled, a 🔒 Login button appears on the Chores and Rewards boards - typing this person's PIN there runs those boards as them for a bit (auto logs out after 45 seconds idle) to claim their own rewards, mark their own chores done, or (if they have approval permission) approve/reject others'.
settings.permissions_admin_hint: Only visible to a Home Assistant admin account - everyone can still do their own chores and claim anything from the Chore Bin regardless of these. Changes here save immediately, not on the Done button below.
settings.kiosk_pin_digits_hint: 4-8 digits. Leave blank and save to clear this person's PIN instead.
settings.screensaver_logins_hint: Check every Home Assistant login that should show the screensaver - everyone else keeps browsing without it, even though Settings itself is shared by the whole household.
settings.screensaver_logins_empty: No other Home Assistant user accounts found besides yours - create one for the wall-mounted device (Settings → People → Users) if you want the screensaver on there but not on your own phone.
settings.screensaver_widgets_hint: Layer weather, a clock, a todo list, or any other Lovelace card on top of the screensaver. The layout is shared by the whole household; below it you can hide individual widgets on just this device.
settings.screensaver_widgets_edit_hint: Drag a widget to move it, drag its bottom-right corner to resize it. This layout is shared by the whole household.
settings.screensaver_widget_gallery_hint: Pick a kind of widget, same as adding a card to a dashboard.
settings.screensaver_widget_type_weather_desc: Current conditions and forecast from a weather entity
settings.screensaver_widget_type_clock_desc: A simple digital clock, no entity needed
settings.screensaver_widget_type_calendar_desc: A month grid for one calendar entity
settings.screensaver_widget_type_camera_desc: A live snapshot from a camera entity
settings.screensaver_widget_type_text_desc: Custom text or Markdown, no entity needed
settings.screensaver_widget_type_custom_desc: Any Lovelace card, written as JSON
settings.screensaver_widget_entity_required: Pick or type an entity first.
settings.screensaver_widget_transparent_label: Transparent background (fill the card, no card background)
settings.screensaver_widget_config_hint: Any Lovelace card's YAML config, written as JSON - the same "type" and other keys you'd use in a dashboard.
settings.screensaver_widget_config_needs_type: Needs at least a "type" field, like a dashboard card's own config.
settings.week_rows_label: Rows shown at once in Week view — this device only
settings.devices_hint: Every dashboard reports its own display settings (Week day count, Current day first, Rows shown in Week view, etc. - see the General tab) here once it's opened at least once. Change a device's values below and hit Push to update it right away - an open dashboard updates instantly, a closed one picks it up the next time it's opened.
settings.devices_empty: No devices have reported in yet - open this dashboard's Settings on another device once to have it show up here.
settings.presets_hint: Save any device's current values above as a named preset, then apply that preset to any other device below.
settings.presets_empty: No presets saved yet - use "Save as preset" under any device above.
settings.holiday_backgrounds_hint: Show a photo on a holiday or special day - normally just behind that day's own column, or check "Expand to full screen" to take over the whole card for just that day, the whole week, or the whole month. If two enabled holidays would both want the screen on the same day, the more specific one wins (a day beats a week, a week beats a month), and if it's still a tie, whichever's own date is closest to today wins. Turn on any of the holidays below, or add a date of your own.
settings.holiday_no_custom_dates: No custom dates yet — add one below.
settings.prevent_duplicate_events_hint: Shows an event once when it's on more than one calendar - the same invite, or the exact same name at the same time - in the first person's column. Off by default. Give separate events different names ("Sam Soccer", "Taylor Soccer") so both show.
settings.right_now_topbar_position_hint: Top shares one row with the nav bar - nav controls on the left (~20%), Right Now on the right (~80%). Left/Right show it as a full sidebar beside the whole grid instead. On a narrow phone screen it always falls back to a plain strip above everything, no matter which you pick here, so the week grid and nav bar always keep enough width to use.
settings.right_now_topbar_size_hint: Small shows just names and the current event. Medium adds presence/sensor pills. Large (the default) adds the clock and weather on top of everything Medium shows - the most info, and the most space it takes up. Only changes the strip's height for Top - Left/Right sidebars already show everything regardless of this setting, since they already have the room.
settings.right_now_topbar_style_hint: Only visible at the Large size (see above) - that's the only tier with room for either one.
settings.right_now_topbar_people_label: Who's shown on the top bar
settings.right_now_topbar_people_hint: Uncheck anyone who shouldn't get a tile on the top bar or sidebar - they still show up everywhere else in this card as usual. Everyone's checked by default, including anyone added later.
settings.agenda_show_meals_hint: Agenda's days, Current day first and Rows shown now follow Week's own settings above - there's no separate Agenda day count anymore. Reminders always show in Agenda alongside calendar events.
settings.alarm_devices_add_label: Tap a device to add it:
settings.alarm_tts_entity_label: Text-to-speech voice (for speakers - not needed for Assist satellites)
settings.alarm_kiosk_hint: A "kiosks"- or "everyone"-tier chore/reward alarm (set per chore/reward, see its own "Who hears this alarm" option) rings on every open Family Hub dashboard logged in as this account, not just the timer's own owner - built for a shared kiosk/wall-tablet login. Admin-only, same as Child account above.
settings.additional_reminders_lists_hint: Extra individual Reminders lists for this person, alongside the one above. The list above always stays their PRIMARY list - it's the only one new reminders (including ones added from the Family Calendar) ever get added to. Tap ★ on any list below to make IT the primary instead.
settings.notify_debug_hint: Traces what Family Hub actually sees for this person right now (as of their last Save, not whatever's unsaved above): which calendars they're subscribed to, which devices get notified, and what's pending or already fired. Admin-only.
settings.screensaver_widget_clock_adaptive_label: Automatic color (light digits on a dark background, dark digits on a light one)
settings.devices_screensaver_hint: Takes effect immediately - no Push needed. Automations can also control this via the device's screensaver switch entity.
settings.devices_privacy_participates_hint: Takes effect immediately - no Push needed. Uncheck so this device keeps showing the calendar while Privacy Mode hides it everywhere else - for example a phone that should stay visible while the kitchen kiosk goes private.
settings.calendar_tag_primary_title: Primary calendar for %name% - tap to unset
settings.screensaver_widget_no_visual_editor: No visual editor available for this card - edit as YAML below.
settings.more_menu_qrf_unifi_show: Also show the network name in the pop-up
settings.more_menu_qr_unifi_hint: Uses the QR code your UniFi Network integration makes for this Wi-Fi network, so it stays right when the password changes.
settings.more_menu_qr_unifi_none: No UniFi Wi-Fi QR codes found. In Home Assistant, open the UniFi Network integration and turn on the "QR code" entity for your Wi-Fi network (it may be disabled by default), or pick any image entity here.
settings.more_menu_unifi_use_instead_text: You use UniFi - its own Wi-Fi QR code stays right when the password changes.
settings.more_menu_unifi_disabled_text: Your UniFi Wi-Fi QR codes are turned off in Home Assistant.
settings.more_menu_unifi_enabled_wait: Turned on. Home Assistant takes about 30 seconds to start them - this switches over on its own.
settings.more_menu_unifi_enable_failed: Couldn't turn them on - only a Home Assistant admin can. In Home Assistant open Settings > Devices & services > UniFi Network and enable the “QR code” entities.
settings.current_day_first_step_label: Navigation step (when Current day always first is On)
settings.dup_merge_info_text: When the same event is on more than one calendar - the same invite, or events with the exact same name at the same time - it's shown once, in the first person's column.
settings.dup_merge_info_tip: If two people really have separate events with the same name at the same time, give them different names so both show - for example "Sam Soccer" and "Taylor Soccer" instead of "Soccer".
settings.categories_hint: Give events and reminders a category and they get a colored bar in that category's color.
settings.holiday_backgrounds_hint_v2: Turn on a holiday or add your own date, then add a photo and, if you like, a theme to switch to. When two would show at once, the shorter one wins (a day beats a week, a week beats a month).
settings.holiday_no_photo_hint: No photo yet - the theme can still change.
settings.holiday_theme_hint: Switches every Family Hub card to this theme while the holiday is showing.
settings.name_pills_hint: The row of names with counts above the calendar (and the Reminders pill). Hide it for more room; the calendar then shows everyone.
settings.calendar_holiday_title: Holiday calendar: its days show as banners under the date instead of as events
settings.hashtags_hint: Tip: type #Name or #Category in an event's title or notes - even from Google or Apple Calendar on your phone. #Emma also shows it on Emma's calendar, #Sports gives it the Sports category, and you can use several.
settings.kiosk_account_note: Kiosk accounts aren't on the Chores board or Rewards and don't get reminders or their own lists.

permissions.can_assign_hint: Can assign chores to other people, not just pick up their own.
permissions.can_edit_chore_hint: Can edit open chores (stars, due date and so on).
permissions.can_star_override_hint: Can create or edit a chore that skips approval, so its stars are paid out right away.
permissions.can_verify_hint: Can approve chores (and star requests) other people have marked done.
permissions.can_complete_any_hint: Can mark any chore done, not just their own.
permissions.no_approval_required_hint: Their own finished chores are approved, and the stars paid out, right away.
permissions.can_override_rewards_hint: Can change what a reward costs, add or subtract anyone's stars, and reverse or clear star history.
permissions.can_add_rewards_hint: Can add rewards to the catalog with a star cost. Without this, what they add is a suggestion that needs approval.
permissions.can_edit_menu_hint: Can edit the weekly meal plan. Without this they can still suggest a meal for any day, and someone with this permission decides.
permissions.can_see_wishlist_claims_hint: Can see who has claimed what on other people's wish lists. A list's owner never sees this. Off by default, so a shared kiosk login can't spoil a surprise.
permissions.can_delete_event_hint: Can delete calendar events, on calendars that allow it.
permissions.can_edit_event_hint: Can edit calendar events, and drag them to another day in Edit mode, on calendars that allow it.
permissions.can_manage_own_routines_hint: Can add, edit, remove and reorder items in their own Morning, Afternoon and Night routines.
permissions.can_manage_any_routines_hint: Can add, edit, remove and reorder anyone's routine items.
permissions.can_toggle_privacy_mode_hint: Can turn Privacy Mode back off with their kiosk PIN. Anyone can turn it on.
